strategies.name: Ethereal Allflame Scarab Farm
strategies.investment: High (Maxroll). Very hard and needs a lot of management. Three embers are about 1,577c (about 3.8 div) per map on 4 Nov 2026.
steps: Run T16 Originator-influenced Crater, chosen for its very high monster density.
Roll maps for 80%+ more Scarabs before you apply the chisel.
Add a Maven's Chisel of Scarabs, 1-5 Blacksmith's Delirium Orbs and a Templar Astrolabe.
Use Eater of Worlds altars for quantity and scarab duplication.
Rush the boss first, then clear the map.
Expect at least 2-3 portal trips to pick up the loot.
Sell the top scarabs. Vendor cheap scarabs 3-for-1.
atlasPassives: Ultimatum cluster, taken only for better odds on Ultimatum scarab drops (mostly Catalysing). You don't run the encounters.
Complete the full Originator questline so Originator maps drop.
scarabs: 3x Allflame Ember of the Ethereal (up to 4 allowed)

strategies.name: Nightmare Boss Rush
strategies.investment: Below average (Maxroll). The three scarabs cost under 10c per map on 4 Nov 2026.
steps: Buy Nightmare maps in bulk through Asynchronous Trade.
Abomination is the main map because it biases Reality fragments. Ziggurat is the slower backup because its boss has invulnerability phases.
Use Searing Exarch influence and Wrath of the Cosmos.
Rush the boss and skip full clears.
Only add mechanics you pass on the way, such as Delirium or Beasts.
Sell the fragments on the Currency Exchange.
atlasPassives: Settlers nodes for Starfall Craters, which can hold Svalinn. Only do them if they are on the way to the boss.
Voidstones raise the chance of Nightmare maps dropping.

strategies.name: Inscribed Ultimatum
strategies.investment: High (Maxroll). Very hard. Scarabs cost 2.5-9c each on 4 Nov 2026.
steps: Run T16 Jungle Valley with Searing Exarch altars.
Clear for Eldritch Altars and click Domination Shrines before you start the encounter.
Skip harsh Ultimatum modifiers (see Dangers).
Keep Inscribed Ultimatums that have 'more Monster Life'.
Vendor weak ones 5:1 to reroll them, using about 20c of value as the cut-off.
scarabs: Optional: Ultimatum Scarab of Dueling or Inscription

strategies.name: Cornucopia Harvest (Maxroll B tier)
steps: Run 8-mod T16 Jungle Valley with Eater of Worlds altars and a Fruiting Astrolabe.
Clear the map and leave the Grove for last.
Kill the Tier 4 seed bosses first (usually Vivid).
Walk out of the thorn ring instead of using a movement skill.
Sell lifeforce on the Currency Exchange.
atlasPassives: Farm of Exile / ImSidVicious tree: poeplanner.com/a/65ht

strategies.name: League Start Harvest (pohx)
strategies.investment: None to low. The base version needs no scarabs.
steps: Run Mesa or City Square.
Juiced version: add Harvest Scarab of Doubling, 2x Monstrous Lineage and 2x Mortal or Sacrifice Fragments.
pohx calls Jungle Valley a bad map for this strategy.
Alternatives: AOEAH runs only Doubling on 8-mod corrupted Mausoleum. ExpCarry lists a City Square rush with one Harvest Scarab and an optional Sacrifice Fragment.
atlasPassives: 40 points: poeplanner.com/a/6ZV1
80 points: poeplanner.com/a/6ZVX
120 points: poeplanner.com/a/6gL0

strategies.name: Unstable Breach
strategies.investment: Extremely high (Maxroll). Above-average difficulty. Still rated the best raw currency farm.
steps: Run T16 Originator Dunes with Eater of Worlds altars and a Grasping Astrolabe.
Add a Maven's Chisel of Avarice and 1-5 Armoursmith's Delirium Orbs.
Roll 92%+ more Currency for the budget version or 140%+ for high investment.
Open at most 2 Unstable Breaches at once. The patch cap is 2, even though Maxroll still says 3.
atlasPassives: Synthesised Stability, plus the generic Breach passives
scarabs: High investment: Horned Scarab of Bloodlines and Cartography Scarab of Risk

strategies.name: Stacked Deck (Cloister)
strategies.investment: Low (Maxroll). Five Cloisters were about 233c per map on 4 Nov 2026.
steps: Run T16 8-mod Jungle Valley with Eater of Worlds.
Complete Rituals so the Doedre's Devoted packs respawn.
Each Devoted monster has a 5% chance to drop a Stacked Deck, and there are 40-60 packs.
Note: Maxroll's page body is still the 3.28 version.
atlasPassives: The 5th map-device slot is needed to run 5 scarabs

strategies.name: Targeted Divination Cards
steps: The Apothecary (Mageblood) now drops only in Cage Map, because Defiled Cathedral was removed.
The Doctor (Headhunter) drops in Burial Chambers.
Scrying Orbs store the map they dropped in, so you can scry that map's cards onto another atlas map.
atlasPassives: Altered Prophecy cluster: its notable gives T14+ maps a 4% chance to drop a Scrying Orb, and its small passives raise card drop chance

strategies.name: Mercenary Rushing
strategies.investment: Low per map. The two scarabs were about 23c together on 4 Nov 2026.
steps: Run white maps, or City Square with a Templar Astrolabe.
Kill the boss and the Mercenary, then leave within about 30 seconds.
Since 3.29.3 you must actually defeat the Infamy Wild Mercenaries to get their loot.
Since 3.29.2 Wild Mercenaries keep fighting after their leader dies.
atlasPassives: Contract Killers: allied Mercenaries deal 100% more damage to Mercenaries and Rogue Exiles
scarabs: Trarthan Scarab of Renown (all Mercenary gear is Unique)
Trarthan Scarab of Infamy (Infamous Mercenary plus 2 Wild Mercenaries)

strategies.name: Curse of the Allflame: Charts & Voyages
strategies.investment: Not stated. Dead Man's Sulphur is about 0.01c each, so a 9,000-Sulphur reroll ceiling is about 94c.
steps: Stock at least 50 Charts. Each Voyage uses 9.
Roll Charts before charting them, because you can't change them once placed.
Reroll border modifiers with up to 9,000 Sulphur, looking for 'Rare Monsters drop an additional Divine Orb'. The cost doubles with each reroll.
If you don't find it, prioritise Operative Strongbox Charts.
Sea Pillars is the only required Unique Room.
After the 7th lantern, return to the Bathysphere or you drown and lose the loot.
From 3.29.3 you can socket up to 3 Cursed Ducats in the Voyage Planner to Empower runs.
atlasPassives: 3.29 added atlas nodes for the Voyage system

strategies.name: Map Farming (Nightmare/Originator)
steps: Run T16 Originator Dunes under Searing Exarch.
Run 8-mod maps that have 100%+ More Maps and sell the rest.
List Nightmare maps in a higher-priced tab and move unsold ones back from time to time.

strategies.name: Kalguuran Map Farming
strategies.investment: Not stated. Needs solid survivability and damage.
steps: Run T16 Originator Jungle Valley with 70%+ More Maps under Searing Exarch.
Sell the 8-mod corrupted Nightmare and Originator maps.

strategies.name: Destructive Play
steps: Run T16 Silo (T14+ Maven-influenced Silo maps).
Kill only the extra Destructive Play bosses and leave the main boss alive.
Sell Maven's Chisels, Shaped Astrolabes and influenced maps.

strategies.name: Alch & Go
steps: Run any map. Transmute, alch or vaal it as needed.
Push to yellow maps for Shrieking Essences.
Sell most drops to fund your build until your Voidstones are done.

strategies.name: 80% Deli Farm (PoE Vault)
steps: Run Dunes with 4 Fine or Diviner's Delirium Orbs.
atlasPassives: poeplanner.com/a/6glO

strategies.name: Manni's Delirium Orb Printer (pohx)
steps: Run Strand, Tropical Island, City Square or Dunes.
Juiced version adds Mania and Neuroses scarabs (T11+).

strategies.name: Strongboxes + Deli + Beyond (pohx, SC only)
steps: Run Haunted Mansion on T16.5 maps rolled for 90%+ Currency or Scarabs.
Avoid -max res, no regen and less recovery mods.
atlasPassives: poeplanner.com/a/65Dr

strategies.name: Starter Atlas with Breach & Shrines (pohx)
strategies.investment: Low. Skip the scarabs if they are expensive.
steps: Run open maps such as Jungle Valley or Beach.
atlasPassives: 80 points: poeplanner.com/a/6g4N (40 and 120-point versions also on pohx.net)

profit.text: Ethereal Allflame: about 42 div/h (rough, seller claim). It used about 100c embers, which now cost about 526c.
Ethereal Allflame rated Good profitability. No div/h given.
Inscribed Ultimatum on white T16 Jungle Valley: about 5.3 div/h net after about 1.2 div/h input (rough, community test).
4x Cloister Stacked Decks: about 11 div/h gross, about 5.2 div/h net (rough, early 3.29 test).
5x Cloister: about 65c in, about 60c net per map (rough). Outdated now that Cloisters are about 47c each.
Cornucopia Jungle Valley: about 11.3 div/h, a little over 1 div per map (rough, a price model, not a measured rate).
Harvest: about 0.2 div per 3-minute map. League start with the full tree: 600-1,000c/h (rough).
Charts and Voyages: 21.65 div/h over 100 Charts and 11 Voyages (rough, one logged test).
Voyage best case: 105 guaranteed divines with the Divine border mod and 15 strongboxes. This is a ceiling, not a per-hour figure.
Mercenary rushing: 15-20 div/h fast, 8-10 div/h slower, without jackpots (rough, no source given).
Fortress boss rush: about 30 div/h with late-league quantity stacking (rough). IGGM's figure of over 25 div/h is from 3.28.
High-investment Abyss with Searing Exarch altars on Jungle Valley: 20-30 div/h, about half from altars (rough, late 3.29 test).
pohx publishes no div/h figures, because they change weekly.
